item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Selection announcement for the awarding of no. 1 Research Assignments, 2026_IR_23_GEO (Univ. PADOVA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-13 16:00
Institution: Univ. PADOVA, Padova
Field: Earth sciences / 04/GEOS-02 Paleontologia, geologia stratigrafica e sedimentologia, geologia strutturale e tettonica

The Research assignment, funded by above cited project, concerns the performance of the research activity specified as follows: • Acquisition and sampling of cultural heritage objects using hyperspectral cameras, including pigments and fossils. • Statistical, spatial, and multitemporal analysis of raster data collected within the HYPERPAST project • Assistance with project management

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Palynological study of Quaternary deposits from the Po Plain and Sheet 165 - Mantova (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-11 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Earth sciences / 04/GEOS-02 Paleontologia, geologia stratigrafica e sedimentologia, geologia strutturale e tettonica

The training programme requires: (i) specific taxonomic expertise in pollen identification and (ii) a general knowledge of the sequence stratigraphy of Late Pleistocene and Holocene successions. Training activities will be conducted at the Department of Biological, Geological and Environmental Sciences (University of Bologna) and at the C.A.A. Palynology and Archaeobotany Laboratory in San Giovanni in Persiceto (Bologna). item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Assessing the relationship between depositional dynamics and ecological quality in Holocene deltaic and shelf successions (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-11 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Earth sciences / 04/GEOS-02 Paleontologia, geologia stratigrafica e sedimentologia, geologia strutturale e tettonica

The activities associated with the training programme require: (i) specific taxonomic expertise in meiofaunal assemblages; (ii) specific expertise in multivariate quantitative analysis and the calculation of ecological indices, and (iii) general knowledge of integrated stratigraphy and sequence stratigraphy applied to Quaternary successions.
